Long, straight, ash blonde hair with a neat center part. Sharp, almond-shaped pale blue eyes with a stern, disciplined expression. Apparent age is a late adolescent with a mature, focused face. Slender, athletic build. A dark navy blue and black military-style dress with a white scarf and a small black cap. Signature details include a black choker and heavy, dark gray metallic submarine rigging arms attached to the back.
